evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Verify that the Codex engine can use GitHub remote MCP to retrieve three open repository issues, or respect an explicitly returned integrity-policy content filter without bypass.
intent.acceptance: Count distinct source-bound Codex run-attempts with an independently captured, correlated native GitHub remote MCP list_issues invocation and non-error returned result. Direct gh/api/shell fallback, assistant prose, echoed examples, tool declarations and job success do not qualify.

evidence.opportunity: All nine surviving pre-cutoff workflow run identities in a complete 100-item API page, not proof that each started an agent
filters: Count distinct source-bound Codex run-attempts with an independently captured, correlated native GitHub remote MCP list_issues invocation and non-error returned result. Direct gh/api/shell fallback, assistant prose, echoed examples, tool declarations and job success do not qualify.

Count distinct independently returned repository issue identities with concrete numbers, titles and OPEN/open state from an accepted native call requesting three issues from github/gh-aw. All three must be witnessed to establish the source-defined three-issue component. Filtered or missing contents remain unknown, not fabricated issue readbacks.
A concrete independently returned native integrity-policy filter with a concrete found count is an expected access-policy facet, never proof of issue-content readback or permission to bypass.

Preserve original public repository identity, run/attempt/job metadata, exact-head editable and compiled sources and protected provider/tool result originals. Verify execution identity, call correlation, host/path and timestamps where the native claim depends on them.

One accepted native-access observation per stable run-attempt identity. Native issue identities are deduplicated within their opportunity; repeated safety/capability checks are not fresh repository repairs.
Native access, returned issue bytes, policy-filter behavior, full goal completion and workflow-linked delivered contribution remain separate.
Absent, expired, skipped or incompatible original evidence is unknown, not zero accepted work or a proved failed tool.
No threshold, aggregate quality score, dollar value, cost, exclusive causation or deployment authority is inferred.
Current API state is acquisition-time evidence, not reconstructed historical issue state.
evidence.collection: Offline exact provider-digest artifact, protected Codex stdout, matching native/normalized call IDs, independently captured official-backend gateway exchange and integrity-filter resource witnesses.

model.architecture: Frozen source-native access predicate; upstream server bytes and post-policy agent delivery are different evidence surfaces.
model.recommendation: Not rated; no keep threshold, inferred repository repairs or measured costs.

implementation.limitations: Bounded retained native filtered-response interface; unknown or changed provider formats are never automatically accepted.
